learning_order:
**Default view: Frost leveling (most common in the guides). Fire and Arcane notes where they differ.**

**Levels 1-10**
- Buy everything: Arcane Intellect, Frostbolt, Conjure Water/Food, Fire Blast, Fireball R2, Polymorph, Frost Nova.
- Comprehend Scroll (6) is 1 silver and starts the Comprehension tradeskill.
- Arcane Missiles only if you plan to level Arcane.

**Levels 10-20**
- Frostbolt and Fire Blast ranks, Frost Armor R2, Conjure Water R2, Arcane Intellect R2, Remove Lesser Curse.
- Skip Dampen Magic, Amplify Magic and Slow Fall.
- Arcane Explosion (14) and Flamestrike (16) only if you plan to AoE-grind.

**Level 20 (big visit)**
- Blink, Evocation, Frostbolt R4, Conjure Water R3, Frost Armor R3, Polymorph R2, your home-city Teleport.
- Mana Shield and Fire Ward are situational. Blizzard only for AoE builds (slow nerfed in Forever).
- Ice Lance / Arcane Blast come from talents (11-point talents).

**Levels 22-30**
- Counterspell (24), Cone of Cold (26), Frost Nova R2, Conjure Mana Agate (28), Ice Armor (30).
- Fire: Scorch (22) and every Fireball rank. Frost/Arcane can skip Fireball and Scorch ranks.
- Frost Blast (24) is new and optional. Talent spell ranks (Pyroblast, Blast Wave, Ice Barrier) are very cheap - always buy them.

**Levels 30-40**
- Keep Frostbolt, Cone of Cold, Conjure Water and mana gems current.
- Mage Armor (34) is optional (Spirit regen buffed in Forever). Ward and Dampen Magic ranks can wait.

**Level 40**
- Frostfire Bolt R1 (new, optional), Frost Nova R3, Polymorph R3, Ice Armor R2.
- Portals are for groups or selling ports - skip solo. Save gold for riding.

**Levels 40-60**
- Main spell ranks, Ice Barrier ranks and mana gems.
- Skip Amplify/Dampen Magic, extra teleports and Polymorph R4 (only longer duration).

**Money tips**
- Water and mana gems are free. Guides suggest Tailoring/Enchanting for gold.
- Do not skip ranks of your main damage spell to save a few silver (dtgre).
- Rank 1 Frostbolt is far more mana-efficient but lower DPS; in Forever, Arcane Concentration and Impact proc less on much lower ranks.
disagreements: Blizzard: Method lists 'Blizzard slow nerfed in Forever' as a mage weakness; Warcraft Tavern Forever still recommends Blizzard for group AoE. Mobalytics (Kargoz, search summary only) says the mage AoE toolkit is dialed back, while Kami-labs expects Cone of Cold / Flamestrike / Frost to 'melt monster packs' thanks to spell power gear.

Arcane timing: Warcraft Tavern Forever presents Arcane as a leveling spec (rush Missile Barrage); Method levels Frost to 42 and only takes Arcane Blast at 57; Mobalytics (search summary only) suggests Frost until 25 then respec Arcane.
Ice Lance learn level: Warcraft Tavern and Metabot say rank 1 at level 20 (talent); the trainer list only shows ranks 2+ starting at 28.
Arcane Wrath: Metabot says learned at level 25 (trainer); the trainer list shows it as talent-gated with rank 2 at 36. Warcraft Tavern says 'Talent Tree, level 25'.
Classic Warcraft Tavern says train every skill 1-20; single-target Frost builds there skip Dampen Magic, Slow Fall, Flamestrike, Amplify Magic, Fireball and Blizzard past rank 1.
forever_differences: Detect Magic is no longer trainable (Metabot changes).
Arcane Intellect lasts 1 hour instead of 30 min (Metabot changes).

New trainer spells: Frost Blast (24, weak frost attack with 40% slow), Frostfire Bolt (40, counts as Fire and Frost, 3s cast), Comprehend Scroll (6, Comprehension minor tradeskill) (Warcraft Tavern deep dive, Metabot).

Ice Lance (Frost) and Arcane Blast (Arcane) are 11-point gold-medal talents; Ice Lance has an 8s cooldown and does 300% vs frozen targets; Arcane Blast stacks to 4, raising its mana cost and buffing other spells (Warcraft Tavern deep dive, Method, Metabot).
Arcane Wrath is new (talent-gated, 3.5s cast, 6s CD, bonus damage from 5% max mana) (Metabot ability page).
Cone of Cold duration 8 -> 6s, slow 50 -> 40%; Improved Blizzard max slow 65 -> 40%; Cold Snap CD 5 -> 10 min (deep dive via Warcraft Tavern/hostedgg, Metabot).
Base damage of Fireball, Frostbolt, Scorch, Pyroblast etc. lowered while spell power scaling is higher (Metabot, Kami-labs) - higher ranks matter somewhat less, gear matters more.
Arcane Concentration and Impact proc less when casting much lower-rank spells, which weakens downranking (deep dive via Warcraft Tavern).
Mage Armor: mana regen from Spirit increased; Arcane Shielding also boosts Mage Armor resistances (deep dive via Warcraft Tavern).
Dampen Magic healing reduction halved; Amplify Magic healing +50% (Metabot changes).
Talents start at 10; Dual Specialization at 40 (deep dive via Warcraft Tavern).
open_questions: Frost Blast: cast time / cooldown not confirmed by a second source; no leveling guide covers it yet.
Frostfire Bolt vs Frostbolt for Frost leveling after 40 is not compared by any guide read.
Teleport: Dalaran (level 50 per Metabot/Kami-labs) is not on the trainer list.
